records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q1 2022
records.text: •Net sales were $291.2 million, an increase of 2.4%

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q1 2022
records.text: We experienced continual strengthening of our backlog of orders throughout 2021, which has grown again during the first quarter of 2022 in both the Infrastructure Solutions and Materials Solutions segments.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q1 2022
records.text: Our business has been significantly affected by the contributory effects of the pandemic such as fluctuations in demand for our products, material price increases, increased shipping costs and lead times from production materials, supplies and parts, labor shortages and increased labor costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q1 2022
records.text: While oil prices have increased throughout the prior year, its price volatility makes it difficult to predict the costs of oil-based products used in road construction such as liquid asphalt and gasoline.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q1 2022
records.text: •Income from operations decreased $4.1 million to $5.4 million
